mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE sales_status = 'ON_SALE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE sales_status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partners WHERE status != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partners WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partners WHERE status = 'INACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE 1=1
AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_status = 'PAID'
AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE (status = 'CANCELED' OR payment_status = 'CANCELED')
AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())

SELECT p.name AS partnerName, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS productCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_price), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_price) - SUM(pov.base_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS netProfit
FROM partners p LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.partner_id = p.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN order_item_options oio ON oio.order_item_id = oi.id LEFT JOIN product_option_values pov ON pov.id = oio.option_value_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT mc.name AS categoryName, COUNT(p.id) AS productCount
FROM menu_categories mc
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = mc.id
GROUP BY mc.name ORDER BY productCount DESC

SELECT CAST(p.id AS VARCHAR) AS productId, p.name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS orderCount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE 1=1
AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_price), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_price) - SUM(COALESCE(pov.base_price, 0) * oi.quantity), 0) AS netProfit
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN order_item_options oio ON oio.order_item_id = oi.id LEFT JOIN product_option_values pov ON pov.id = oio.option_value_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'PAID'
AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())
GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT CAST(p.id AS VARCHAR) AS productId, p.name AS productName, v.value AS optionName, CAST(g.id AS VARCHAR) AS groupId, g.valid_until AS validUntil, (g.valid_until - CURRENT_DATE) AS daysLeft, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeCount FROM ticket_coupon_groups g JOIN products p ON p.id = g.product_id LEFT JOIN product_option_values v ON v.id = g.product_option_value_id LEFT JOIN ticket_coupons c ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE p.visible = true AND p.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' AND g.valid_until BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND (CURRENT_DATE + #{days}) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, v.value, g.id, g.valid_until HAVING COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE') > 0 ORDER BY g.valid_until, p.name

SELECT CAST(p.id AS VARCHAR) AS productId, p.name AS productName, v.value AS optionName, COUNT(c.id) FILTER ( WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND c.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE ) AS activeCount FROM ticket_coupon_groups g JOIN products p ON p.id = g.product_id LEFT JOIN product_option_values v ON v.id = g.product_option_value_id LEFT JOIN ticket_coupons c ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE p.visible = true AND p.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, g.product_option_value_id, v.value HAVING COUNT(c.id) FILTER ( WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND c.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE ) < #{threshold} ORDER BY activeCount, p.name
